text:
The proposal at `dictation-debug/solid/requirements.md` is clear, so I rewrote nothing and logged one "clear" line in `flags.jsonl`.

It is a brief for agents, so I checked it as one. It has four numbered steps in order, each with its proof. It also has a "Never" list and a "Done when" list.

`text-check` raised one flag, on `past-work.md` in the same folder (778 words of prose, limit 500). That file is generated by `Server/PastWork.mjs` and marked "do not hand-edit", so I left it. I didn't look at any page in a browser, because the proposal has no `page.js`.
